payload.text: 0084 (low, cc's): seven tests of a missing tool's refusal skip wherever the tool is installed. Design approved (path_without, a farm of links, one ln per PATH directory, last to first; proof by mutation and a farm control; the farm made once per test under BATS_TEST_TMPDIR; the header says the per-directory glob stays inside ARG_MAX). Built on main's head, which carries 0082 since 853a947 (it changed test_helper.bash, cryptz.bats and macoz.bats), in a worktree under ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-cc/; after 0083's prez part (vc's order, 19 Oct 12:07Z: 0081, 0085, 0083's prez part, 0084, 0087's design).
